summary: This report outlines the lane code backend implementation in LocalWorkService._candidates as defined by ADR-0066. The decision requires a pooled lane to declare a specific code backend from its available options, defaulting to omen-dense-27b for the deep lane. The _candidates method handles non-delivery submissions on pooled lanes by selecting the declared code backend, while refusing such work if no backend is declared. On retries, the previously recorded provider is retained.
